title: What If Chinese Were Latinized? A Counterfactual Study of Input Representation, Tokenization, and Language Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.32525v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: If Chinese had been Latinized, as the Latinxua Sin Wenz movement proposed, what would it have meant for Chinese NLP? Homophones and tone marking complicate the answer. We convert Chinese corpora to syllable-separated Pinyin and train superBPE tokenizers from scratch. The resulting Pinyin vocabularies not only exhibit expected homophone collisions, but also show approximately 10% higher fertility than characters. An alternative BPE configuration changes the relative fertility of the two representations. We further pretrain Llama-style models on Chinese characters and Pinyin. The Pinyin models perform worse on per-character perplexity, homophone disambiguation, and overall ZhoBLiMP minimal-pair accuracy. An exploratory phonological probe yields near-chance performance for both representations. The broader implication is that written input representations are not merely neutral encodings. Choices for representations affect language modeling

translated_title: 如果中文被拉丁化了会怎样？关于输入表示、分词与语言建模的反事实研究
translated_abstract: 如果中文按照拉丁化新文字运动所提议的那样被拉丁化，这对中文自然语言处理意味着什么？同音字和声调标注使这一问题变得复杂。我们将中文语料转换为按音节分隔的拼音，并从头训练superBPE分词器。所得的拼音词表不仅出现了预期中的同音字冲突，其切分率还比汉字高约10%。而采用另一种BPE配置则会改变两种表示之间的相对切分率。我们进一步在汉字和拼音上分别预训练Llama风格的语言模型。拼音模型在单字困惑度、同音字消歧以及ZhoBLiMP整体最小对准确率上均表现更差。一项探索性的音系学探测显示，两种表示的性能都接近随机水平。更广泛的启示是：书面输入表示并非中性的编码方式，表示方案的选择会影响语言建模的效果。
tldr: 该研究通过反事实实验将中文语料转换为拼音并从头训练分词器与Llama风格语言模型，发现拼音表示会导致更高的切分率、更差的同音字消歧和语言建模性能，证明书面输入表示的选择并非中性编码，而会实质性影响语言建模效果。
en_tdlr: Through a counterfactual study converting Chinese corpora to Pinyin and training superBPE tokenizers and Llama-style models from scratch, this paper shows that Pinyin representation leads to higher fertility, worse homophone disambiguation, and poorer language modeling performance, demonstrating that written input representations are not neutral encodings and their choices substantively affect language modeling.
